title: The First Strike
text:
*Your first strike has succeeded. The conspiracy is weakened — but not broken. Harren still has men, Varketh is still coming, and the city doesn't know how close it came to falling.*

*Dawn breaks over Ashenmoor, painting the grey buildings in shades of amber. The market is stirring, oblivious to the shadow war being fought in their streets. You have a brief window before the enemy regroups.*

*Marta finds you near the fountain, a worried crease on her brow.*

Marta: "Word is spreading. Harren knows something went wrong. He's pulled his people off the streets — gone to ground. If we're going to finish this, it has to be now."

choices.text: March on Harren's stronghold with everything you've got
Secure the north gate first — block Varketh's army
